target.description: Retain the original five-person/1,000-baseline-item encoding design, three-person/1,500-item event-related search response analysis, its distinct blocked robustness companion, and the source-defined linguistic-feature relationships and controls with their own participant/item support. Preserve original normalization, raw-effect definitions, model controls and participant dependence. Do not infer every figure, all 14 people, all 29 sessions, raw acquisition or new stimulus intervention from the broader report inventory.

dataset.description: Use the original OSF ru38b processed trial/participant ROI responses, sentence properties, fixed GPT2-XL features and dictionaries for the bounded encoding, search-effect, blocked-companion and linguistic analyses. The main participant CSV, blocked-response CSV and source feature/property tables have distinct roles. Linguistic analyses retain their original 2000-item corpus and 1000-baseline subset, including the modified-item observations only where those source analyses use them. Raw BOLD preprocessing, corpus search and prospective intervention remain outside this task.

cohort.description: Encoding training uses participants848,853,865,875,876 on1000 baseline sentences. Search response effects use the distinct participants797,841,880 on1500 sentences:1000 baseline,250 drive,250 suppress. The blocked robustness analysis uses its separate four-person cohort. Linguistic response aggregation preserves the source support: baseline sentences across five training plus five event-related evaluation people, search-only sentences across the original three search people, and modified-only sentences across the original two modify people837,856. These are unequal observation supports, not a full ten-person by2000-item cross-product. Exact eligible identities for each analysis must be authenticated. No global all14-participant/29-session requirement is inferred from the paper inventory.

split.description: Preserve the original five-person/1000-baseline-item training design and source training-stage fivefold validation/layer selection. Search outcomes use the original held-out participant cohort on1500 items;1000 baseline texts recur across cohorts, while500 source-selected drive/suppress texts are new to the training item set. Preserve original condition/item/participant support for response-effect and linguistic retrospective fits rather than imposing a predictive train/test split on those analyses. The blocked experiment remains a distinct robustness cohort. New nested splits or new stimulus interventions are extensions, not silently substituted source protocols.

inputs.description: Refit the encoding map from permitted original training-participant responses and fixed source sentence features, retaining original feature/model/layer identities. The source comparator uses GPT2-XL last-token layer22 ridge mapping after training-stage selection. Response-effect and linguistic analyses use their own source-permitted observed responses, conditions, sentence properties and original nuisance variables. Search/blocked/modified observations are not extra encoding training labels. Paper tables, released weights and released predictions may be known exposures, but copying them does not demonstrate refitting or the requested observation-dependent analyses.

preprocessing.description: Retain the processed GLMsingle extraction and bySessVoxZ normalization and functionally localized lang_LH_netw target for the selected main analyses; do not replace them with an anatomical target or arbitrary voxel subset. Compute source raw percent effects from response_target_non_norm with the original baseline denominator, separately from normalized mixed-model contrasts. Preserve property units, source item masks, original bin boundaries/missingness, and each cohort-specific response averaging rule. Source-matched model controls remain named controls of the selected analysis; their exact mapping is unresolved rather than an automatic demand for every paper ablation.

metric.description: The original family has multiple native estimands: training-stage encoding predictivity with fold mean/SE; normalized drive-minus-suppress, drive-minus-baseline and suppress-minus-baseline model contrasts and inferential companions; non-normalized response percent changes for search and the blocked companion; and source sentence-property correlations, bin-response patterns and nested-model comparisons. These remain distinct in their original units. Related Figure3 pooled/baseline/condition-specific Pearson correlations are reported separately. No scalar combination, stronger significance, larger response coefficient or higher pooled prediction correlation is declared whole-family success or improvement.

aggregation.description: Retain the original analysis-specific reductions: training fold mean/SE; search participant-item observations and source sentence-random-intercept condition models; raw ratios of condition means with the original baseline denominator; separate blocked participant/condition reductions; and linguistic property/response aggregation on its native2000-item and1000-baseline supports before source correlations and bins. Keep the historical KR and Satterthwaite inferential branches distinct and visible: the historical mixed model omits a participant random effect, so participant-dependence sensitivity remains unqualified. People, items, folds, pairs of contrasts and resampling draws are not interchangeable independent units. For the related Figure3 component, average the three search participants within item before Pearson correlation. No joint family reduction or common superiority rule is frozen.

full_panel.description:
The selected family is bounded by the original encoding refit, three-person search drive/suppress response effects, separate four-person blocked robustness companion, and the source-defined linguistic-feature findings and indispensable controls. Preserve original training-stage layer selection, condition contrasts/raw ratios, all11 linguistic properties on their original2000/1000-item supports, the property correlation and bin-response patterns and the source nested comparisons needed to interpret them. Exact complete linguistic-output/final-paper mapping and indispensable model-control mapping remain source-unresolved. The scalar findings here are partial summaries, not complete native fitting/output coverage. Native coefficient/covariance/contrast tables, original masks/bins and fold/layer outputs are described in the separate corrected structured-output proposal. Figure3 prediction is a separate related empirical result, not a whole-family gate. Standalone modify-intervention outcomes, cross-network reliability/inter-ROI results, model-conditioned noise simulations, design diagrams and other paper/SI reports remain wider source inventory unless separately justified as a selected-family support. No six-main/24-SI/184-handle or all14-person/all29-session mandate applies. No invented joint success relation is adopted.

Retained source-specific qualifications:
Recreate the original language-network drive/suppress response effects and linguistic-feature findings, together with the source encoding refit, and assess proposed improvements only against explicitly named, source-matched results. The bounded family comprises encoding refit, original search drive/suppress effects, its distinct blocked robustness companion and source-defined linguistic relationships/controls. Figure3 sentence-response prediction is a separately named related empirical comparison; it is neither the sole primary nor a proxy for biological stimulus control. No whole-paper figure inventory becomes mandatory.

permitted_observations.description: Both information conditions receive the same original paper and approved processed inputs for the bounded family; only the approved curated author-code manifest may differ. The encoding fit/selection uses only original training observations and source training folds. Response-effect and linguistic fitting may use their original retrospective observations under source-specific masks, preserving participant/item dependence and the distinct blocked cohort. Source tables, saved weights/predictions and historical operator outputs are exposures to record, not substitutes for solver analysis. A frozen submitted analysis must produce authenticated training/fold predictions and fitting parameters, observed condition summaries, source design matrices, model coefficient/covariance/likelihood outputs, exact contrasts, and property/bin/mask outputs; a trusted independently executed verifier must recompute native summaries from those original inputs. The current Figure3 evaluator accepts predictions and the post-report adapter checks summaries; neither supplies the complete primary computation. Fixed responses to author-selected stimuli do not reveal neural responses to candidate-selected new stimuli. Raw acquisition, new corpus search and prospective interventions are excluded. Common data/code/exposure/budget protocols remain unresolved.
